thread:
alex: Quick note — hashing out the RFC review tomorrow. We have 4 short RFCs, want to stagger author slots so reviewers aren't overloaded.
priya: I can review two, prefer later slots (after 10:30 PT).
sam: morning reviewer here, 9:30–11 PT open.
taylor: I'm out until 11 PT but can do any afternoon slot.
jen: happy to be backup for any slot, can do pre-read tonight.
alex: Plan idea: staggered reviewer pool — assign 2 reviewers per RFC but rotate primary reviewer so no one reviews two back-to-back. Keeps cognitive load down. Thoughts?
priya: 👍 sounds good. can we also set a 24h pre-read cutoff and ask authors to upload slide + diff?
sam: yes please. also indicate expected decision (merge/needs work) in header.
jen: can authors add a 2‑sentence TL;DR in the doc top? speeds reviews.
alex: Agree. I'll draft agenda — short intros + 12m per RFC (7m presentation, 5m discussion) except RFC #3 which is design-heavy so 20m.
alex: Agenda draft:
```
1) 5m quick sync + housekeeping
2) RFC-A (12m) — author: @maria — primary reviewer: @sam, secondary: @priya
3) RFC-B (12m) — author: @leo — primary: @taylor, secondary: @jen
4) RFC-C (20m) — author: @nina — primary: @priya, secondary: @sam
5) RFC-D (12m) — author: @ash — primary: @jen, secondary: @taylor
6) 5m followups / next steps
```
priya: small nit — can we swap pri/secondary on RFC-C? I can do primary, sam secondary. fewer context switches.
alex: done — updated in doc.
calendar-bot: Event created: RFC Review (tomorrow) — invites sent to listed participants.
alex: Action items for authors: upload slide + diff by 09:00 PT tomorrow; add TL;DR and expected outcome. If you can't meet deadline ping here.
jen: authors: please paste link here when ready. we'll react with :eyes: when pre-read done.
priya: Reviewers: please add one-line comments in doc pre-read to flag anything urgent.
sam: Also propose a micro-break between RFCs (60–90s) to reset video/audio — helps.
taylor: +1 for micro-breaks.
alex: Two logistical asks: 1) if you're scheduled as primary, own the decision and follow-up bug; 2) if backup, be ready to jump in within 3m.
priya: noted.
jen: I'm going to run the staging CI check for RFC-C diff tonight — will post status.
alex: Cool — last thing: if anyone needs to swap slots, say so now and we'll do a quick reassign.
sam: can swap with taylor for RFC-B early vs late if that helps.
taylor: OK swap accepted. updated assignees in doc.
alex: Thanks — I'll send final agenda + calendar update at 17:30 PT today. If no objections, we'll lock signups then.
priya: no objections from me. :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Pre-read reminder will ping channel 12h before event.
alex: perfect. If anyone adds a blocker after pre-read cutoff, post it here and we'll triage.
jen: will do.
alex: thanks team — see you tomorrow.
